purpose.summary: Correct the public reindex matrix review-state binding without changing tested behavior or consensus.
scope: Bind the runner to the exact signed ERGON-CHANGE-0005 parent and its two modified harness paths.
Carry accepted review metadata in a new record so the unchanged public reindex scenario can execute.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, activation, native-asset, optional-indexing, testnet, or mainnet-parameter change.
No change to the reindex feature, build roles, scenario IDs, lifecycle canaries, or observable comparison oracles.
No private source, history, operator material, host metadata, binary, or incoming evidence.

signature_policy.public_key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFN47Qs8VW9ty+v0tf31kv6pMpyOMxWWLXZ0Pv5MWVCI Ergon Lab Git commit signing (ErgonSurfer)

exclusions: Private history, operator material, host metadata, and unrelated private product material are excluded.

files.test_reachability: Runs the identity-bound fail-closed public matrix and requires both reconstruction lifecycle markers.
Covers runner contracts, reconstruction lifecycle canaries, record binding, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public correction with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed correction commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed two-node legacy/candidate coexistence, restart, and reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: Alternating mining and clean same-datadir restart preserve exact chain, UTXO commitment, and raw-tip projections.
Full reindex and chainstate-only reindex on both roles emit fresh lifecycle markers, restore the exact pre-rebuild snapshot, and accept one new block mined by each role.
failure_conditions: Any process, lifecycle-marker, chain, UTXO, raw-tip, post-rebuild mining, cleanup, or identity divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the baseline daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the candidate daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged inherited feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-equivalent selection.
failure_conditions: Any inherited-selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 with the reviewed public dependency profile
macOS arm64 local contradiction testing only

limitations: ERGON-CHANGE-0005 published the reindex scenario, but its under-review decision state made the governed runner stop before every build and scenario.
The public report observes only the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0006 candidate and cannot retroactively promote ERGON-CHANGE-0005.
The four passing scenarios establish a bounded short-chain regtest observation with cross-node synchronization, clean restart, full reindex, and chainstate reindex on both roles.

Pruning, corrupt storage, interrupted reconstruction, crash recovery, consensus and deep reorganization behavior, historical-chain replay, sustained operation, public-network peers, and mainnet remain untested.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality, and the dependency profile is not locked.
Operator-binary equivalence and mainnet coexistence remain unproved.
This evidence has an assembled-component ceiling and is not an independent reproduction pack.
counterevidence: At public commit ee1f3535b5941e6b898d3c8ffebf17585ba2416e, ergon-change-0005.json says status under-review and decision pending while run_matrix.py requires status accepted plus reviewer and date; the unequal states force a pre-execution failure.
The successful local prototype run used the same reindex feature postimage but is excluded from public evidence and cannot repair the public record binding.

No contradiction was observed inside the four declared public oracles, but pruning, corrupt or interrupted rebuild, crash recovery, consensus and deep reorganization, operator-binary, historical-chain, real-datadir, sustained public-network, and mainnet surfaces remain evidence gaps.
